G5514.d: feminine of apparently a primary word; "green"; Chloë, a Christian female:--Chloe.

G5615.d: from ὡς and an adverb from αὐτός; as thus, i.e. in the same way:--even so, likewise, after the same (in like) manner.

G5585.d: from ψῆφος; to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. (generally) to compute:--count.

G5623.d: from the same as ὠφέλεια; to be useful, i.e. to benefit:--advantage, better, prevail, profit.

G5622.d: from a derivative of the base of ὠφέλιμος; usefulness, i.e. benefit:--advantage, profit.

G5596.d: diminutive from a derivative of the base of ψώχω; a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful:--sop.

G5621.d: diminutive of οὖς; an earlet, i.e. one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear:--ear.

G5534.d: third person singular of the same as χράομαι or χράω used impersonally; it needs (must or should) be:--ought.

G5597.d: prolongation from the same base as ψάλλω; to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand):--rub.

G5594.d: a primary verb; to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from πνέω, which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of ἀήρ, which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively):--wax cold.

G5528.d: apparently a primary word; a "court" or "garden", i.e. (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation:--blade, grass, hay.

G5590.d: from ψύχω; breath, i.e. (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from πνεῦμα, which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from ζωή, which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the Hebrew נֶפֶשׁ, רוּחַ and חַי):--heart (+ -ily), life, mind, soul, + us, + you.

G5532.d: from the base of χράομαι or χρή; employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution:--business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want.

G5525.d: of uncertain derivation; a ring, i.e. round dance ("choir":--dancing.

G5605.d: from ὠδίν; to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively):--travail in (birth).

G5586.d: from the same as ψηλαφάω; a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote:--stone, voice.

G5501.d: irregular comparative of κακός; from an obsolete equivalent (of uncertain derivation); more evil or aggravated (physically, mentally or morally):--sorer, worse.

G5603.d: from ᾄδω; a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while ὕμνος denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and ψαλμός still more specially, a Hebrew cantillation):--song.

G5537.d: from χρῆμα; to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of χράομαι), i.e. divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of χρεία) to constitute a firm for business, i.e. (generally) bear as a title:--be called, be admonished (warned) of God, reveal, speak.

G5566.d: of Latin origin; the north-west wind:--north west.

G5613.d: probably adverb of comparative from ὅς; which how, i.e. in that manner (very variously used, as follows):--about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, X with all speed.

G5553.d: diminutive of χρυσός; a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin:--gold.

G5551.d: from a presumed compound of χρόνος and the base of τρίβος; to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger):--spend time.

G5568.d: from ψάλλω; a set piece of music, i.e. a sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the Psalms:--psalm. Compare ᾠδή.

G5581.d: from ψευδής and ὄνομα; untruly named:--falsely so called.

G5522.d: from the base of χειμών; a heap (as poured out), i.e. rubbish; loose dirt:--dust.

G5572.d: from ψευδής and διδάσκαλος; a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine:--false teacher.

G5526.d: from χόρτος; to fodder, i.e. (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance):--feed, fill, satisfy.

G5550.d: of uncertain derivation; a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from καιρός, which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from αἰών, which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay:--+ years old, season, space, (X often-)time(-s), (a) while.

G5591.d: from ψυχή; sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from πνευματικός, which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from φυσικός, which is the lower or bestial nature):--natural, sensual.

G5617.d: of Hebrew origin (הוֹשֵׁעַ); Hosee (i.e. Hoshea), an Israelite:--Osee.

G5587.d: from a derivative of (a whisper; by implication, a slander; probably akin to ψεύδομαι); whispering, i.e. secret detraction:--whispering.

G5612.d: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to "roar":--roar.

G5589.d: diminutive from a derivative of the base of ψάλλω (meaning a crumb); a little bit or morsel:--crumb.

G5601.d: of Hebrew origin (עוֹבֵד); Obed, an Israelite:--Obed.

G5511.d: of uncertain derivation; a military cloak:--robe.

G5554.d: from χρυσός and δακτύλιος; gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry:--with a gold ring.

G5571.d: from ψεύδομαι; untrue, i.e. erroneous, deceitful, wicked:--false, liar.

G5540.d: from χράομαι; employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body):--use.

G5521.d: feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish hue); "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.):--gall.

G5604.d: akin to ὀδύνη; a pang or throe, especially of childbirth:--pain, sorrow, travail.

G5544.d: from χρηστός; usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor):--gentleness, good(-ness), kindness.

G5510.d: perhaps akin to the base of χάσμα (χαλάω) or χειμών (as descending or empty); snow:--snow.

G5559.d: probably akin to the base of χράομαι through the idea of handling; the body (properly, its surface or skin):--body.

G5500.d: from a comparative of χείρ and (to stretch); to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint:--choose, ordain.

G5546.d: from Χριστός; a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ:--Christian.

G5558.d: from χρυσός; to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments:--deck.

G5543.d: from χράομαι; employed, i.e. (by implication) useful (in manner or morals):--better, easy, good(-ness), gracious, kind.

G5520.d: from χολή; to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric"):--be angry.

G5560.d: apparently a primary word; "halt", i.e. limping:--cripple, halt, lame.

G5557.d: perhaps from the base of χράομαι (through the idea of the utility of the metal); gold; by extension, a golden article, as an ornament or coin:--gold.

G5508.d: of uncertain derivation; Chios, an island in the Mediterranean:--Chios.

G5573.d: from ψευδής and λέγω; mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine:--speaking lies.

G5533.d: from a derivative of χράω and ὀφειλέτης; a loan-ower, i.e. indebted person:--debtor.

G5616.d: from ὡς and εἰ; as if:--about, as (it had been, it were), like (as).

G5584.d: from the base of ψάλλω (compare ψῆφος); to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for:--feel after, handle, touch.

G5614.d: of Hebrew origin (יָשַׁע and נָא); oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration:--hosanna.

G5503.d: feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of χάσμα through the idea of deficiency; a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively:--widow.

G5512.d: from a derivative probably of χεῖλος; to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at:--mock.

G5611.d: from ὥρα; belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e. (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively)):--beautiful.

G5555.d: from χρυσός and λίθος; gold-stone, i.e. a yellow gem ("chrysolite"):--chrysolite.

G5538.d: from χρηματίζω; a divine response or revelation:--answer of God.

G5549.d: from χρόνος; to take time, i.e. linger:--delay, tarry.

G5531.d: probably the same as the base of χράομαι; to loan:--lend.

G5561.d: feminine of a derivative of the base of χάσμα through the idea of empty expanse; room, i.e. a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants):--coast, county, fields, ground, land, region. Compare τόπος.

G5606.d: perhaps from the alternate of φέρω; the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne):--shoulder.

G5624.d: from a form of ὄφελος; helpful or serviceable, i.e. advantageous:--profit(-able).

G5542.d: from a compound of χρηστός and λέγω; fair speech, i.e. plausibility:--good words.

G5547.d: from χρίω; anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus:--Christ.

G5535.d: from χρεία; to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of:--(have) need.

G5516.d: the 22nd, 14th and an obsolete letter (στίγμα as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the 5th and 6th), used as numbers; denoting respectively 600, 60 and 6; 666 as a numeral:--six hundred threescore and six.

G5595.d: from the base of ψωμίον; to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish:--(bestow to) feed.

G5524.d: from a compound of χορός and ἄγω; to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish:--give, minister.

G5502.d: plural of Hebrew origin (כְּרוּב); "cherubim" (i.e. cherubs or kerubim):--cherubims.

G5580.d: from ψευδής and Χριστός; a spurious Messiah:--false Christ.

G5575.d: from ψευδής and a kindred form of μάρτυς; a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony:--false witness.

G5608.d: middle voice from an apparently primary (a sum or price); to purchase (synonymous with the earlier πίμπρημι):-- buy.

G5602.d: from an adverb form of ὅδε; in this same spot, i.e. here or hither:--here, hither, (in) this place, there.

G5563.d: from χώρα; to place room between, i.e. part; reflexively, to go away:--depart, put asunder, separate.

G5515.d: from the same as Χλόη; greenish, i.e. verdant, dun-colored:--green, pale.

G5565.d: adverb from χώρα; at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition):--beside, by itself, without.

G5530.d: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from χείρ, to handle); to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner:--entreat, use. Compare χράω; χρή.

G5556.d: from χρυσός and (a leek); a greenish-yellow gem ("chrysoprase"):--chrysoprase.

G5518.d: of uncertain derivation; a chœnix or certain dry measure:--measure.

G5562.d: from χώρα; to be in (give) space, i.e. (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively):--come, contain, go, have place, (can, be room to) receive.

G5599.d: a primary interjection; as a sign of the vocative case, O; as a note of exclamation, oh:--O.

G5569.d: from ψευδής and ἀδελφός; a spurious brother, i.e. pretended associate:--false brethren.

G5507.d: plural of uncertain affinity; a thousand:--thousand.

G5517.d: from χόος; dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene:--earthy.

G5570.d: from ψευδής and ἀπόστολος; a spurious apostle, i.e. pretended pracher:--false teacher.

G5548.d: probably akin to χράομαι through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service:--anoint.

G5620.d: from ὡς and τέ; so too, i.e. thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow):--(insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore.

G5610.d: apparently a primary word; an "hour" (literally or figuratively):--day, hour, instant, season, X short, (even-)tide, (high) time.

G5619.d: from ὥσπερ and εἰ; just as if, i.e. as it were:--as.

G5588.d: from the same as ψιθυρισμός; a secret calumniator:--whisperer.

G5523.d: of uncertain derivation; Chorazin, a place in Palestine:--Chorazin.

G5576.d: from ψευδομάρτυρ; to be an untrue testifier, i.e. offer falsehood in evidence:--be a false witness.

G5618.d: from ὡς and περ; just as, i.e. exactly like:--(even, like) as.

G5578.d: from ψευδής and προφήτης; a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor:--false prophet.

G5509.d: of foreign origin (כְּתֹנֶת); a tunic or shirt:--clothes, coat, garment.

G5574.d: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood:--falsely, lie.

G5552.d: from χρυσός; made of gold:--of gold, golden.

G5541.d: middle voice from χρηστός; to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently:--be kind.

G5506.d: from χίλιοι and ἄρχω; the commander of a thousand soldiers ("chiliarch"; i.e. colonel:--(chief, high) captain.

G5582.d: from ψεύδομαι; a fabrication, i.e. falsehood:--lie.

G5564.d: diminutive of χώρα; a spot or plot of ground:--field, land, parcel of ground, place, possession.

G5529.d: of uncertain origin; Chuzas, an officer of Herod:--Chuza.

G5504.d: of uncertain derivation; "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto:--yesterday.

G5567.d: probably strengthened from (to rub or touch the surface; compare ψώχω); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes):--make melody, sing (psalms).

G5545.d: from χρίω; an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit:--anointing, unction.
